queries.name: Daftar Invoice Belum Lunas
queries.purpose: Menampilkan daftar invoice penjualan customer yang masih memiliki outstanding.
queries.query: SELECT si.siid AS invoice_id, si.sinotransaksi AS nomor_invoice, si.sitgl AS tanggal_invoice, si.sitgljatuhtempo AS tanggal_jatuh_tempo, c.kid AS customer_id, c.knama AS nama_customer, si.simatauang AS mata_uang, si.sitotaltransaksi AS total_invoice, si.sijmlbayar AS total_terbayar, (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) AS outstanding, CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CURDATE() > si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) ELSE 0 END AS hari_terlambat, si.sistatuslunas AS status_lunas, si.sistatus AS status_dokumen FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND (COALESCE(si.sistatuslunas, '') <> 'LUNAS' OR (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) > 0) AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) > 0 ORDER BY hari_terlambat DESC, outstanding DESC, si.sitgl ASC

queries.name: Outstanding dan Risiko per Customer
queries.purpose: Merangkum total outstanding per customer sekaligus mengurutkan customer dengan risiko keterlambatan tertinggi.
queries.query: SELECT c.kid AS customer_id, c.knama AS nama_customer, COUNT(si.siid) AS jumlah_invoice_terbuka, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) AS total_outstanding, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND CURDATE() > si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_outstanding, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND CURDATE() > si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jumlah_invoice_overdue, MAX(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND CURDATE() > si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) ELSE 0 END) AS maksimum_hari_terlambat FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND (COALESCE(si.sistatuslunas, '') <> 'LUNAS' OR (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) > 0) AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) > 0 GROUP BY c.kid, c.knama ORDER BY overdue_outstanding DESC, maksimum_hari_terlambat DESC, total_outstanding DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Distribusi Aging Bucket
queries.purpose: Mengelompokkan outstanding invoice ke bucket umur piutang untuk analisis aging.
queries.query: SELECT CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NULL THEN 'Tanpa Jatuh Tempo' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) <= 0 THEN 'Belum Jatuh Tempo' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30 Hari' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN '31-60 Hari' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN '61-90 Hari' ELSE '>90 Hari' END AS aging_bucket, COUNT(si.siid) AS jumlah_invoice, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) AS total_outstanding FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND (COALESCE(si.sistatuslunas, '') <> 'LUNAS' OR (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) > 0) AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlabayar) > 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NULL THEN 'Tanpa Jatuh Tempo' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) <= 0 THEN 'Belum Jatuh Tempo' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30 Hari' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN '31-60 Hari' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN '61-90 Hari' ELSE '>90 Hari' END ORDER BY CASE aging_bucket WHEN 'Tanpa Jatuh Tempo' THEN 1 WHEN 'Belum Jatuh Tempo' THEN 2 WHEN '1-30 Hari' THEN 3 WHEN '31-60 Hari' THEN 4 WHEN '61-90 Hari' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

queries.query: SELECT status_invoice, SUM(sisa_invoice) AS nominal_outstanding FROM ( SELECT si.siid, si.sitotaltransaksi, COALESCE(icagg.nilai_tertagih, 0) AS nilai_tertagih, COALESCE(pvagg.nilai_terbayar, 0) AS nilai_terbayar, si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(pvagg.nilai_terbayar, 0) AS sisa_invoice, CASE WHEN COALESCE(icagg.nilai_tertagih, 0) = 0 THEN 'Belum Tertagih' WHEN COALESCE(icagg.nilai_tertagih, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(pvagg.nilai_terbayar, 0) = 0 THEN 'Sudah Tertagih Belum Dibayar' WHEN COALESCE(pvagg.nilai_terbayar, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(pvagg.nilai_terbayar, 0) < si.sitotaltransaksi THEN 'Dibayar Sebagian' WHEN COALESCE(pvagg.nilai_terbayar, 0) >= si.sitotaltransaksi THEN 'Lunas / Hampir Lunas' ELSE 'Status Lainnya' END AS status_invoice FROM m5_si si LEFT JOIN ( SELECT icd.idtransaksi AS siid, SUM(COALESCE(icd.jmlbayar, icd.rencana, 0)) AS nilai_tertagih FROM m5_ic_detail icd INNER JOIN m5_ic ic ON icd.idic = ic.icid WHERE icd.sumber = 'SI' GROUP BY icd.idtransaksi ) icagg ON si.siid = icagg.siid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pvd.idtransaksi AS siid, SUM(COALESCE(pvd.jmlbayar, 0)) AS nilai_terbayar FROM m5_pv_detail pvd INNER JOIN m5_pv pv ON pvd.idpv = pv.pvid WHERE pvd.sumber = 'SI' GROUP BY pvd.idtransaksi ) pvagg ON si.siid = pvagg.siid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 ) x GROUP BY status_invoice ORDER BY nominal_outstanding DESC

queries.query: SELECT c.knama AS customer_nama, COUNT(si.siid) AS jumlah_invoice, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) AS outstanding_total, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) <= 0 THEN si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS bucket_belum_jatuh_tempo, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS bucket_1_30_hari, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS bucket_31_60_hari, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS bucket_61_90_hari, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) > 90 THEN si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS bucket_gt_90_hari FROM m5_si AS si INNER JOIN m1_contact AS c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid AND c.kaktif = 1 WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND si.sitgl >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0 GROUP BY c.kid, c.knama ORDER BY outstanding_total DESC LIMIT 100

    c.knama AS customer_name,
    0 AS sales_invoice_count,

queries.name: Mutasi Poin Bulanan
queries.purpose: Menampilkan total poin masuk, poin keluar, dan perubahan bersih per bulan dari penyesuaian/manual point movement yang tercatat.
queries.query: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(spa.spatgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan, SUM(COALESCE(spad.poinmasuk, 0)) AS total_poin_masuk, SUM(COALESCE(spad.poinkeluar, 0)) AS total_poin_keluar, SUM(COALESCE(spad.poinmasuk, 0) - COALESCE(spad.poinkeluar, 0)) AS mutasi_bersih FROM m5_spa AS spa INNER JOIN m5_spa_detail AS spad ON spad.idspa = spa.spaid INNER JOIN m1_contact AS c ON spad.kontak = c.kid WHERE c.kaktif = 1 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(spa.spatgl, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY bulan ASC

IFNULL(si.sijmlbayar, 0), 0) > 0 AND si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo), 0) ELSE NULL END), 2) AS avg_overdue_days, MAX(CASE WHEN GREATEST(si.sitotaltransaksi - IFNULL(si.sijmlbayar, 0), 0) > 0 AND si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo), 0) ELSE 0 END) AS max_overdue_days, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN GREATEST(si.sitotaltransaksi - IFNULL(si.sijmlbayar, 0), 0) > 0 THEN si.siid END) AS invoice_outstanding_count, ROUND(IFNULL(sr.total_retur, 0), 2) AS total_retur, IFNULL(sr.jumlah_dokumen_retur, 0) AS jumlah_dokumen_retur, IFNULL(cl.baris_macet, 0) AS fulfillment_macet_count, ROUND((SUM(GREATEST(si.sitotaltransaksi - IFNULL(si.sijmlbayar, 0), 0)) * 0.40) + (IFNULL(AVG(CASE WHEN GREATEST(si.sitotaltransaksi - IFNULL(si.sijmlbayar, 0), 0) > 0 AND si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo), 0) ELSE NULL END), 0) * 0.25) + (IFNULL(sr.total_retur, 0) * 0.20) + (IFNULL(cl.baris_macet, 0) * 0.15), 2) AS skor_risiko_indikatif FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sr.srcustomer AS customer_id, SUM(IFNULL(sr.srtotaltransaksi, 0)) AS total_retur, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.srid) AS jumlah_dokumen_retur FROM m5_sr sr GROUP BY sr.srcustomer ) sr ON sr.customer_id = c.kid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cl.clcustomer AS customer_id, COUNT(*) AS baris_macet FROM m5_cl cl WHERE COALESCE(cl.clstatusrealisasi, '') NOT IN ('SELESAI', 'LUNAS', 'CLOSE', 'CLOSED') OR COALESCE(cl.clstatuspi, '') NOT IN ('SELESAI', 'LUNAS', 'CLOSE', 'CLOSED', '') OR COALESCE(cl.clstatuspl, '') NOT IN ('SELESAI', 'LUNAS', 'CLOSE', 'CLOSED', '') OR COALESCE(cl.clstatusdo, '') NOT IN ('SELESAI', 'LUNAS', 'CLOSE', 'CLOSED', '') OR COALESCE(cl.clstatusdr, '') NOT IN ('SELESAI', 'LUNAS', 'CLOSE', 'CLOSED', '') OR COALESCE(cl.clstatussi, '') NOT IN ('SELESAI', 'LUNAS', 'CLOSE', 'CLOSED', '') GROUP BY cl.clcustomer ) cl ON cl.customer_id = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 GROUP BY c.kid, c.kkode, c.knama, sr.total_retur, sr.jumlah_dokumen_retur, cl.baris_macet HAVING outstanding_total > 0 OR total_retur > 0 OR fulfillment_macet_count > 0 ORDER BY skor_risiko_indikatif DESC, outstanding_total DESC, avg_overdue_days DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Detail Invoice Outstanding Tertinggi
queries.purpose: Drill-down invoice outstanding dan aging untuk customer berisiko.
queries.query: SELECT c.kkode AS kode_customer, c.knama AS nama_customer, si.sinotransaksi AS nomor_invoice, si.sitgl AS tanggal_invoice, si.sitgljatuhtempo AS tanggal_jatuh_tempo, ROUND(si.sitotaltransaksi, 2) AS total_invoice, ROUND(IFNULL(si.sijmlbayar, 0), 2) AS total_terbayar, ROUND(GREATEST(si.sitotaltransaksi - IFNULL(si.sijmlbayar, 0), 0), 2) AS outstanding, CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo), 0) ELSE NULL END AS overdue_days, si.sistatuslunas AS status_lunas, si.sistatus AS status_dokumen FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND GREATEST(si.sitotaltransaksi - IFNULL(si.sijmlbayar, 0), 0) > 0 ORDER BY outstanding DESC, overdue_days DESC LIMIT 100
